description: Source code for a video encoder using libvpx, implementing VP8/VP9 encoding with support for scalability modes, color space updates, and frame processing.

classes.name: VpxVideoEncoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video encoder using libvpx for VP8/VP9 codecs, supporting scalable video coding, color space management, and frame encoding.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with specified profile, options, and callbacks.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a given video frame with specified options and callback.

methods.name: GetFrameDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of a frame based on metadata, options, or timing.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder, processing all pending frames.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves encoded output packets and passes them to the output callback.

methods.name: UpdateEncoderColorSpace
methods.description: Sets the encoder's color space parameters based on the last frame's color space.
